newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto offers to buy rest of Calgene.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto offers to buy rest of Calgene.

text.p: Monsanto Co. said Tuesday it has offered to acquire the remainder of Calgene Inc. for about $217 million, or $7.25 a share.
Monsanto, a St. Louis-based agricultural, pharmaceutical and food ingredients company, currently owns 54.6 percent of the outstanding shares of the Davis, Calif.-based biotechnology company.
Calgene has about 66.25 million shares and the offer for the remaining shares would amount to just over $217 million, Monsanto said.
The proposal is subject to the approval of a special committee of the disinterested directors of Calgene's board, Monsanto said.
A Calgene officials were not immediately available to comment.
